properties.name: Every failure gets its raw error searched in the design; the full /root-cause skill runs at the moment a CAUSE is about to be written — not on every failure
properties.statement:
Set by Anthony on 2026-09-06 (his words: "I'd like to make the use of /root-cause more automatic by the agent when it finds an issue in implementing/creating design artifacts or in its testing … probably some caveats about which types of issues … might not be a blanket rule"), ruling on dec:idea-root-cause-runs-at-the-moment-a-cause-is-about-to-be-written-not-on-every-failure: the tiered option (c) as the floor and the cause-moment trigger (b) as the judgement above it; the blanket rule (a) rejected as ritual.

═══ TIER 1 — ON ANY FAILURE, ALWAYS: SEARCH BEFORE YOU THINK ═══
Whenever a command, test, build, tool call or check fails while building or testing — however trivial it looks — run step ② of the root-cause skill first: `search_design` on the RAW error text (the exact string, not your summary of it) and READ what comes back. Measured cold at 0.08 s, so cost is never the reason to skip it. If a recorded cause matches, apply the recorded remedy and COUNT the recurrence on the record that holds the cause (revise the fact, or note the occurrence); do not re-derive it. This step alone would have prevented both measured failures on this project — the error of 2026-08-22 that reached eleven occurrences while its cause sat in the graph, and the 2026-09-06 re-fix of an already-fixed defect (fact:a-defect-fixed-but-never-closed-on-the-record-was-re-fixed-wrongly-a-day-later).

═══ TIER 2 — THE FULL SKILL, AT THE MOMENT A CAUSE IS ABOUT TO BE WRITTEN ═══
Run the whole root-cause skill (get_skill root-cause; steps ①–⑨, every step leaving an artifact) the moment you have formed an explanation for something you did not predict. The trigger is not the failure; it is the sentence: "because", "the problem is", "it must be", "that explains it". Concretely, that moment arrives on: an unpredicted test failure; a measurement or count you cannot account for (something slower, larger or emptier than it should be — the quiet case the skill's own author missed); a surprise in your own build ("why did that pass?"); a defect reported from the field (already rule:field-feedback-issues-are-root-caused-and-ideas-are-brainstormed); and any "because" written before a discriminating measurement was taken.

═══ EXEMPT FROM TIER 2 — NEVER FROM TIER 1 ═══
The full skill is NOT run on a failure that never reaches a cause: an error whose remedy is stated in the error itself (a compile error naming the line; a refusal that lists the legal values or fields; a missing argument); a known-class friction whose cause tier 1 found already recorded — but COUNT it (five argument-shape refusals in one triage on 2026-09-05 were evidence, not five investigations); a typo. The exemption is bounded by CONSTRUCTION, not by judgement: it covers errors you read, fix and move on from without ever writing a cause. "This one is obvious" is not an exemption — the skill's own author-case says the obvious one is the case to run it on, and the overconfident symptom-fix that Anthony described produces no failing command at all, which is why tier 2 keys on the cause moment rather than on a failure.

═══ WHY TIERED AND NOT BLANKET ═══
The skill costs real time, and run on every trivial refusal it becomes a ritual; a step performed ritually stops being performed at all (the skill's own warning). Tier 1 is the cheapest honest floor and catches the recorded-cause class mechanically; it does not reach the abstract third of defect facts that no error string matches (68 of 192, measured), which is what tier 2 is for.

═══ WHAT COMPLIANCE LEAVES BEHIND ═══
Tier 1 leaves a counted recurrence when it hits and nothing when it misses — the floor is invisible on a miss, which is accepted. Tier 2 leaves a dated TemporalFact per cause carrying the candidates considered, the discriminating measurement, a CAUSES edge from the artifact holding the cause, and a stated bound on what was not established; and a test observed failing first (rule:an-issue-is-root-caused-then-pinned-by-a-test-then-fixed). A fix recorded as defect_fix or test_failure_fix whose touched artifacts carry no CAUSES edge did not follow this rule, whatever it concluded — that is the detector owed under dec:idea-how-does-root-cause-become-automatic-rule-hook-detector-or-composition, the third leg of fact:vocabulary-needs-three-legs.

ENFORCEMENT IS DELIBERATELY UNSTATED, as for its sibling rule: whether a fix with no recorded cause should block anything is a policy Anthony has not ruled on. The detector will report it as a gap first; a gate is the later question.
